title: French government's draft budget relies on tax hikes to take back control over public finances

France faces historic purchasing power crisis: Since 2024, families have lost €1,200/year on average
subhead: Real wages have been falling since 2019 – a rare phenomenon – but, for a long time, social transfers and income from assets made up for it. In 2025 and 2026, that is no longer the case. As a result, average purchasing power fell over two consecutive years, something that only happened twice since 1960.

title: Where to live? How climate change is forcing us to rethink our relationship with our surroundings
subhead: Excessive heat, water shortages, rising sea levels: A place's habitability depends first and foremost on physical thresholds. But it also depends on the relationship between a space and the people who live there, which plays a key role in how people adapt to climate change.

title: One in Russia, the other in Ukraine: The Moreau brothers, divided by war
